abstract: Aim: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) has a dismal prognosis, and innovative therapies are needed. We developed a phase I pilot, non-viral gene therapy (CYL-02) encoding SST2 and DCK::UMK genes complexed with a polyethyleneimine non-viral vector to sensitize tumours to gemcitabine chemotherapy, which showed excellent feasibility and safety. Methods: An open-label, multicentre, randomized Phase 2 trial (NCT02806687) compared CYL-02 [two intratumoral endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided injections one month apart] + gemcitabine injected weekly vs. gemcitabine alone in 70 patients (n = 35 per arm) with locally advanced PDAC. The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS). Secondary endpoints were overall survival (OS), tumour response, safety, and ancillary studies. Results: PFS did not differ between arms. Unexpectedly, OS was worse in the gene therapy + chemotherapy arm. Exploratory analyses revealed no differences in clinical status, baseline characteristics, or the number of patients receiving second-line therapy, with the exception of a more frequent use of FOLFOX post-progression in the control arm, which could explain this difference. Proteomic profiling identified clusterin (CLU) as a candidate treatment-induced resistance factor in patients: CYL-02 + gemcitabine significantly increased circulating CLU levels, while gemcitabine alone did not. In vitro and in vivo models confirmed CLU induction by DCK combined with gemcitabine and demonstrated that CLU silencing restored chemosensitivity, reducing experimental tumour volume in mice. Conclusion: CLU induction in patients receiving CYL-02 and gemcitabine may explain adaptive resistance and lack of efficacy of gene therapy. These results provide a rationale for combining CYL-02 and gemcitabine with CLU targeting to overcome resistance in pancreatic cancer.
key_points_ko: 총 70명의 국소 진행성 췌장암 환자(각 군당 35명)를 대상으로 CYL-02 병용요법과 gemcitabine 단독요법을 비교했습니다.
무진행 생존기간(PFS)은 두 치료 군 간에 차이가 없었습니다.
전체 생존기간(OS)은 유전자 치료 병용군에서 더 나쁘게 나타났습니다.
CYL-02와 gemcitabine 병용은 순환 클러스터인(CLU) 수치를 유의하게 증가시켜 적응 저항성을 유발하는 것으로 나타났습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 국소 진행성 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 70명을 대상으로 비바이러스성 유전자 치료제인 CYL-02와 gemcitabine 병용요법을 gemcitabine 단독요법과 비교한 무작위 다기관 2상 임상시험(NCT02806687)입니다. 1차 평가변수인 무진행 생존기간(PFS)은 두 군 간에 차이가 없었으나, 전체 생존기간(OS)은 유전자 치료 병용군에서 오히려 더 나빴습니다. 탐색적 분석 및 실험 모델을 통해 유전자 치료와 gemcitabine 병용이 치료 유도성 저항성 인자인 클러스터인(clusterin, CLU)을 증가시킨다는 사실이 확인되었습니다. 저자는 이러한 결과가 췌장암에서 저항성을 극복하기 위해 CLU를 표적 치료와 결합할 근거를 제공한다고 결론지었습니다.
title: Randomized multicentre Phase 2 clinical trial of non-viral gene therapy for pancreatic cancer: clinical and molecular findings
title_ko: 췌장암에 대한 비바이러스성 유전자 치료의 무작위 다기관 2상 임상시험: 임상 및 분자적 결과
